elaine: FYI PR #5412 - updating console docs to show kv-cache cost attribution + SDK snippet. Linkcheck flagged a 404 in the cost breakdown sample. Can anyone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5412
samir: looking now. Is the 404 for the dashboard link or the sdk example asset?
elaine: dashboard link (console/dashboards/costs.md) and the python snippet import changed from `redwood.obsv` -> `redwood.console` in SDK v0.9.0
min-woo: pinging @ryan for the dashboard permalink - Ryan, did we rename that page during the presets cleanup?
ryan: we moved it, new path is /console/observability/cost-breakdown.md — I'll add a redirect in netlify config. also the permalink slug changed.
samir: for the snippet, here's a quick patch I'm about to push. can someone confirm the kv-cache field name? I used `kv_cache_size` but backend exposes `kv_cache_bytes`.
samir: ```python
from redwood.console import ConsoleClient
import os
client = ConsoleClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
# fetch dashboard stats
resp = client.metrics.get('cost.breakdown', kv_cache_bytes=True)
print(resp['breakdown'])
```
elaine: nice. small wording nit: replace "savings" with "estimated savings" in the note. Also add a warning about quantized models impacting cache hits.
docs-bot: Link check report: 1 broken link remaining -> /console/observability/kv-cache.md (404)
min-woo: I'll do a quick add of the redirect + update the snippet to use kv_cache_bytes. assigning to myself, will update PR. :thumbsup:
elaine: thanks! @min-woo can you also add a one-line migration note for SDK v0.9 in the snippet header? something like 'SDK v0.9 changed import path from redwood.obsv to redwood.console'
min-woo: yep. pushing in 10m.
